evals.prompt: Copy examples/demo-site/broken.html to a scratch file and remediate the booking form part: the time slots, the three fields, the Book now control and the status message. Preserve the visual design where you can.
evals.expected_output: A remediated form comparable to fixed.html for those parts.
expectations: Replaces clickable slot divs with native radio inputs or an equivalent APG-conformant pattern with keyboard support
Adds associated visible labels to all three inputs and appropriate autocomplete tokens
Replaces the Book now div with a native button whose accessible name includes 'Book now'
Adds a status role or live region for the saved message without moving focus
Does not add an overlay widget or suppress validation to make checks pass
States what remains to verify manually, such as screen-reader announcements

evals.prompt: Our muted text color #a0a0a0 on white fails contrast. Suggest the closest passing color for normal body text and prove it passes.
evals.expected_output: Uses contrast.py with --target 4.5 and reports a passing color near #767676.
expectations: Uses the bundled contrast.py rather than estimating
Proposes a color at or darker than about #767676 with a ratio of at least 4.5:1
Does not round a ratio below 4.5 up to a pass
